resources.string: Connect wallet · Phantom, Solflare, Seed Vault
Connect your wallet first: every save is a real swap that your wallet app approves.
Three things: I answer your calls and write the notes, I keep your follow-ups and reminders, and I watch your Solana wallet. Payments always wait for your approval.
Try: “Who called today?”, “What’s my balance?” or “Remind me to call back.” Every payment waits for your approval in the wallet.
